title: 第555章 恢复巅峰第554章 对抗
lines: 看着脸色苍白，虚弱无力的邵海生，季杭笑着道：“可惜了，你没机会见证我的辉煌……嗯？这是什么？”话还未说完，他立刻意识到不妙，在他的身体周围，不知何时出现了一团黑气，跟邵海生身体表面的一模一样，“这……这怎么回事？”他愣了愣，急忙转头看向头顶的那名男子，“主人，你……你是不是弄错了，我可是你忠心的奴仆。”
听到这话，男子淡淡一笑，“既然是忠心的奴仆，那就为我奉献你自己吧。”
“不，不要，你骗我！”季杭面色一变，大声的咆哮道：“你承诺过我的，难道你忘了刚才说的话吗？”
“我当然没忘，只是，我没想到你们竟会蠢到相信我。”男子咧着嘴，不再搭理满脸绝望的季杭，双目直视着头顶。
此刻，在他的顶端，出现了一片巨大的漩涡，一道璀璨夺目的光芒从天而降，投射到他的身上。沐浴在光芒中，男子的脸上顿时露出一丝满足的笑意，“不错！有了你们这些祭品，我的实力总算可以恢复了。”说到这，他望向不远处的季杭，“你放心，作为我的回报，我会把你们炼制成活尸，助我一起征战天下。”
“不，我不想变成活尸。放了我，我保证会全心全意的为你服务。”
男子摇了摇头，神情漠然道：“相比有野心和欲望的手下，我更喜欢没有思想的人，因为他们永远都不会背叛。”
“哈哈哈！”一旁的邵海生大笑道：“季杭，现在你该知道了吧，没有人会重用一个叛徒。”
“不，不，不是的……”季杭喃喃自语，面若死灰。
也不知道过了多久，男子周身环绕的璀璨光芒渐渐消散，与此同时，所有人体内的力量都被剥离，现在的他们只剩下一具虚软无力的身体，再没有任何力量反抗了。
随着那股黑气消失，众人的身体立刻失去控制，纷纷从半空中坠落下来。
“从今天开始，你们都将成为我活尸军团中的一份子。这，就是我赐予你们的永生。”男子张开双臂，天空中凭空出现了无数黑气，阴森诡异，弥漫整个区域。
眼看着那些黑气侵袭而来，众人脸色惨白，忙不迭的起身逃开。可是，力量被剥离的他们早已变得虚弱无比，跑出没多远，就栽倒在了地上，再也爬不起来。
当黑气涌入体内，凄惨的叫声此起彼伏的，随即归于平静。不过一小会的功夫，已经有不少人变成了活尸，双目空洞无神，意识也被吞噬。
看到这一幕，邵海生一行人不由叹了口气，虽然心里早有了准备，但是，真到了这个时候，还是有些不甘。
“流沙，流沙……”卿曼容看着不远处的那个土坑，吃力的站起身，步伐艰难的挪动着，身体摇摇晃晃，似乎随时都会跌倒。突然，她脚下一个踉跄，双腿一软，一头扑倒在地上，嘴里发出痛苦的呻吟声。
“别去了。”尚霓裳轻咬着薄唇，“已经没有意义了，这一劫，我们都别想逃过。”
听到这话，卿曼容苦笑了一声，“你是不是觉得特别后悔？如果你当初听了江来的建议，不趟这摊浑水，估计你现在什么事都没有。”
“那又有什么用，不过是早晚的问题，我宁愿早点死，也不想苟延残喘的活着，只是……不知道江来在做什么？”尚霓裳喃喃道：“他恐怕还不知道这里发生的事情。”
“别想了。”卿曼容轻轻摇了摇头，“就算他知道了又能怎样，虽然他的实力很强，但跟那个人比起来，他根本没有获胜的可能。”
说话间，一道道黑气从头顶落下，环绕在她们的周身，顺着肌肤慢慢渗透进去。
感受到身体表面传来的寒冷，尚霓裳任命的闭上了眼睛，而脑海中，却是不自觉的浮现出了江来的模样，“希望下辈子还有机会再见面吧。”
过了一会，她惊讶的发现，入侵体内的那股寒冷竟然渐渐消失了，取而代之的是一股温暖的感觉，好像有一股平和的力量在修复她受损的身体。
“怎么回事？”
她连忙睁开双眼，定睛看去，只见对面的卿曼容抬起头，呆呆的看着半空。见状，她顺着对方的目光看去，只见一道笔挺的身姿傲立在空中，那棱角分明的脸庞如此熟悉。
“江来……”她蠕动着唇角，难以置信的看着对方。她怎么都没想到，会在自己生命的最后一刻见到他。可是，她明明记得江来说过，他没兴趣掺和这种事情，既然如此，那他为什么会到这里来。
此时，江来凝视着不远处的那名男子，眉头微皱。果然不出所料，这怪物已经出世了。而且，对方的实力恐怕已经恢复到了巅峰。
真是个麻烦！
他无奈的摇摇头，本来只是想找到余水溪，把最后一颗宝石弄到手，结果当他赶到的时候，却看到那些道门中人在黑气的侵蚀下，全都脱变成了活尸，其中还包括尚霓裳和卿曼容等人。让他眼睁睁的看着朋友出事，实在做不到。
“你是什么人？”此刻，男子打量着突然到来的江来，言语中透着一丝好奇。他已经察觉到，自己召唤出来的那些黑气居然被驱散了，更重要的是，对方只是轻描淡写的就做到了。
“你就是桑吉吧，总算见到你本人了。”沉默了好一会，江来才缓缓开口。
此话一出，桑吉微微一怔，饶有兴趣的笑道：“有意思，你居然知道我是谁，我还以为我的名字早已经被人遗忘了。”
不仅是桑吉，包括在场的众人，都感到有些惊讶，谁都没想到，江来竟然能一语道破对方的身份。由此可见，江来知道的事情比他们要多得多。
“桑吉，收手吧，别再把灾难带到这个世界来了，难道你造成的杀孽还不够多？因为你的贪婪和野心，多少人葬送了性命。”
“哼！你知道的事情还不少，既然你知道我是谁，又清楚我的经历，那你就该知道，这一刻我已经等待了数千年，无论是谁，都别想阻止我。”
听到这话，江来耸了耸肩，“既然如此，那我们之间没什么好谈的了。”说着，他勾了勾手指，“来！让我见识一下禁忌力量的真正实力。”
content_en:
Looking at the pale and weak Shao Haisheng, Ji Hang smiled and said: "It's a pity that you don't have the chance to witness my glory... huh? What is this?" Before he finished speaking, he immediately realized that something was wrong. Around his body, something appeared at some point. There was a cloud of black energy, which was exactly the same as the one on the surface of Shao Haisheng's body. "What...what's going on?" He was stunned, and hurriedly turned to look at the man above his head, "Master, you...are you mistaken? I am your loyal slave."
Hearing this, the man smiled lightly and said, "Since you are a loyal slave, then dedicate yourself to me."
"No, no, you lied to me!" Ji Hang's expression changed and he roared loudly: "You promised me, have you forgotten what you just said?"
"Of course I haven't forgotten it, but I didn't expect you would be stupid enough to believe me." The man grinned and stopped talking to the desperate Ji Hang, looking directly at the top of his head.
At this moment, a huge vortex appeared at the top of him, and a dazzling light fell from the sky and projected onto him. Bathed in the light, a satisfied smile suddenly appeared on the man's face, "Yes! With your sacrifices, my strength can finally be restored." Having said this, he looked at Ji Hang not far away, "Don't worry, in return, I will refine you into living corpses to help me conquer the world together."
"No, I don't want to become a living corpse. Let me go, and I promise to serve you wholeheartedly."
The man shook his head and said with an indifferent expression: "Compared with subordinates who have ambitions and desires, I prefer people without ideas, because they will never betray."
"Hahaha!" Shao Haisheng on the side laughed and said: "Ji Hang, you should know by now, no one will reuse a traitor."
"No, no, it's not..." Ji Hang muttered to himself, his face ashen.
I don't know how long it took, but the bright light surrounding the man gradually dissipated. At the same time, the power in everyone's body was stripped away, and now they were left with only a weak body, without any power to resist anymore.
As the black energy disappeared, everyone's bodies immediately lost control and fell from mid-air.
"From today on, you will all become a part of my living corpse army. This is the eternal life I give you." The man opened his arms, and countless black air appeared out of thin air in the sky, which was eerie and strange, filling the entire area.
Seeing the black energy invading, everyone turned pale and hurriedly got up and ran away. However, their strength had been stripped away and they had become extremely weak. They fell to the ground not long after running far and could not get up again.
When the black energy poured into the body, miserable screams came one after another, and then calmed down. However, within a short time, many people had turned into living corpses, their eyes were empty and lifeless, and their consciousness had been swallowed up.
Seeing this scene, Shao Haisheng and his party couldn't help but sigh. Although they had been prepared in their hearts, they were still a little unwilling when this time came.
"Quicksand, quicksand..." Qing Manrong looked at the pit not far away, stood up with difficulty, moved with difficulty, her body was swaying, and she seemed to fall down at any time. Suddenly, she stumbled, her legs softened, and she fell to the ground, moaning in pain.
"Don't go." Shang Nishang bit her thin lips lightly, "It's meaningless anymore. We can't even think of escaping this disaster."
Hearing this, Qing Manrong smiled bitterly, "Do you feel particularly regretful? If you had listened to Jiang Lai's advice and not waded into this muddy water, I guess nothing would have happened to you now."
"What's the use? It's just a matter of time. I'd rather die early than linger on, but... I don't know what Jiang Lai is doing?" Shang Nichang murmured: "I'm afraid he doesn't know what's happening here."
"Don't think about it." Qing Manrong shook her head gently, "So what if he knows. Although he is very strong, compared with that person, he has no chance of winning."
As they spoke, streaks of black energy fell from the top of their heads, surrounded their bodies, and slowly penetrated along their skin.
Feeling the coldness coming from the surface of her body, Shang Nishang closed her eyes reluctantly, but in her mind, Jiang Lai's appearance appeared unconsciously, "I hope we have a chance to meet again in the next life."
After a while, she was surprised to find that the coldness that invaded her body gradually disappeared, replaced by a warm feeling, as if a peaceful force was repairing her damaged body.
"What's going on?"
She quickly opened her eyes and looked intently, only to see Qing Manrong opposite her raising her head and staring blankly into the air. Seeing this, she followed the other person's gaze and saw a straight figure standing proudly in the air, with that angular face so familiar.
"Jiang Lai..." She twitched the corners of her lips and looked at him in disbelief. She never expected that she would see him at the last moment of her life. However, she clearly remembered Jiang Lai saying that he had no interest in getting involved in this kind of thing. If that was the case, then why was he here.
At this time, Jiang Lai stared at the man not far away, frowning slightly. As expected, this monster has been born. Moreover, the opponent's strength may have returned to its peak.
What a hassle!
He shook his head helplessly. He originally just wanted to find Yu Shuixi and get the last gem, but when he arrived, he saw that all the people in the Taoist sect had turned into living corpses under the erosion of the black energy, including Shang Nichang, Qing Manrong and others. It was really impossible for him to watch something happen to his friend.
"Who are you?" At this moment, the man looked at Jiang Lai who suddenly arrived, with a hint of curiosity in his words. He had noticed that the black energy he had summoned had actually been dispelled, and more importantly, the other party had done it in an understatement.
"You are Sanji, I finally see you in person." After a long silence, Jiang Lai slowly spoke.
As soon as these words came out, Sanji was slightly startled and smiled with interest: "Interesting, you actually know who I am. I thought my name had been forgotten long ago."
Not only Sangji, but also everyone present was a little surprised. No one expected that Jiang Lai could reveal the other party's identity with one word. It can be seen that Jiang Lai knows much more than they do.
"Sanji, stop it. Stop bringing disasters to this world. Haven't you caused enough killings? How many people have lost their lives because of your greed and ambition."
"Hmph! You know a lot of things. Since you know who I am and my experience, you should know that I have been waiting for this moment for thousands of years. No one can stop me."
Hearing this, Jiang Lai shrugged, "In that case, there is nothing to talk about between us." As he said that, he hooked his fingers and said, "Come on! Let me see the true strength of the forbidden power."
